segments.normalizedSource: ```swift struct Scratchpad: App { var body: some Scene { WindowGroup { HeightResizingExample() } .windowResizability(.contentSize) } } struct HeightResizingExample: View { @State private var height: CGFloat = 300 var body: some View { ZStack(alignment: .topLeading) { Color.red .overlay { Text("Tap to toggle") .foregroundStyle(.white) } } .onTapGesture { withAnimation(.easeInOut) { height = height == 300 ? 700 : 300 } } .frame(width: 250, height: height) .windowResizeAnchor(.top) } } ```
